about_the_game:
Taste of Power is a real-time strategy game that combines strategic depth with lightning-fast tactical combat in massive medieval battles. Set in an alternate historical world, witness an epic three-way clash as Europe, China, and the Arab Caliphate vie for continental supremacy. This unique collision of civilizations presents a bold new vision of the Middle Ages.

Revolutionary Smart Action System

Built on our innovative Smart Action concept, victory requires dynamic empire expansion through city construction, large-scale warfare, and technological advancement. We've reimagined the classic RTS formula by automating tedious micromanagement, freeing you to focus on grand strategic execution and empire development.

Intuitive Command at Scale

Our groundbreaking UI design enables effortless control of massive armies while preserving the option for precise unit micromanagement. Command thousands of troops with ease, or dive deep into tactical positioning—the choice is yours.

Three Unique Civilizations

Master three distinct factions, each featuring exclusive units, technologies, and strategic capabilities:

  • European Forces: Heavily armored knights and advanced siege engines

  • Chinese Empire: Disciplined formations and innovative gunpowder weapons

  • Arab Caliphate: Swift cavalry and sophisticated engineering

Every unit type possesses distinct strengths and vulnerabilities, creating rock-paper-scissors dynamics that reward tactical thinking.

Endless Strategic Possibilities

Multiple development paths within each faction offer countless combinations of warriors and technologies. Will you focus on overwhelming cavalry charges, impenetrable defensive lines, or devastating siege warfare? Each choice shapes your civilization's identity and opens unique strategic opportunities.

Unprecedented Medieval Arsenal

Experience the most diverse military toolkit ever seen in a medieval strategy game. Deploy artillery barrages, construct elaborate fortifications, plant explosive mines, harness alchemical weapons, and unleash incendiary attacks. Master these advanced systems to snatch victory from the jaws of defeat.

The Ultimate Strategic Test

Taste of Power demands split-second decision-making under pressure. Can you adapt your strategy in real-time? Will you outmaneuver ruthless opponents when every second counts?

Prove your tactical supremacy in this revolutionary take on medieval warfare. Command vast armies, forge mighty empires, and discover what it truly means to have a Taste of Power.

short_description: Forge your legacy in a RTS focused on strategic thinking, speed and massive battles. The game is set in an alternate medieval, where Europe, China, and the Timurids compete for supremacy. As a player, you'll expand your realm, advance powerful technologies, and lead your warriors into epic battles.
